title: Fast Gaming DNS
name: fast-dns
modal: This switches your DNS servers to Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) and Google (8.8.8.8) on all active adapters. Revert restores automatic DNS.
description: Switches to fast Cloudflare and Google DNS for quicker matchmaking and browsing
deepDescription:
Slow ISP DNS delays matchmaking, downloads and browsing. This sets fast public DNS on every active adapter:

- Primary DNS → 1.1.1.1 (Cloudflare)
- Secondary DNS → 8.8.8.8 (Google)

Revert restores automatic (DHCP) DNS.
